outcome.answer: The closest match is LigBench [1], a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based research idea generation with fine-grained, more reliable assessment and a pairwise idea-judgment dataset. RINoBench [2], SoundnessBench [4], and InnoEval [6] are also related, but they focus on novelty judgment, methodological soundness, and knowledge-grounded multi-perspective idea evaluation rather than the same unified research idea benchmark.
